meaning: Indicates alternatives; 'A or B', 'either A or B'.
formation: Phrase A + あるいは + Phrase B
ja: 今日は映画を見るあるいはショッピングをする予定です。
romaji: Kyou wa eiga wo miru aruiwa shoppingu wo suru yotei desu.
en: Today, I plan to either watch a movie or go shopping.

meaning: Expresses that in addition to A, there is also B; 'moreover', 'besides', 'not only', 'but also'.
formation: Sentence A + おまけに  + Sentence B
ja: 彼は遅刻した。おまけに宿題も忘れた。
romaji: Kare wa chikoku shita. Omake ni shukudai mo wasureta.
en: He was late. Moreover, he forgot his homework.

meaning: Indicates a sudden change or shift in the topic or situation; 'now then', 'well', 'so'.
formation: A + さて + B
ja: 今日の仕事が終わった。さて、これから帰るか。
romaji: Kyou no shigoto ga owatta. Sate, kore kara kaeru ka.
en: Today's work is done. Now then, shall we go home?

meaning: Expressing additional information; 'moreover', 'besides', 'furthermore'.
formation: Statement A + 。しかも + Statement B。
ja: この料理は美味しいです。しかも、安いです。
romaji: Kono ryouri wa oishii desu. Shikamo, yasui desu.
en: This dish is delicious. Moreover, it is cheap.

pattern: A。したがって B。(A. Shitagatte B.)
meaning: Express a cause-and-effect relationship; 'therefore', 'consequently', 'so'.
formation: A + したがって + B
ja: 今日は雨が降っています。したがって、傘を持って行きましょう。
romaji: Kyou wa ame ga futteimasu. Shitagatte, kasa wo motte ikimashou.
en: It is raining today. Therefore, let's bring an umbrella.

meaning: Express that A is equivalent to B; 'in other words', 'namely', 'that is to say'.
formation: Phrase A + すなわち + Phrase B
ja: 私は立派な成果を出したい、すなわち、成功したいのです。
romaji: Watashi wa rippana seika wo dashitai, sunawachi, seikou shitai no desu.
en: I want to achieve great results, in other words, I want to succeed.

meaning: Indicates that when action A is done, action or event B follows; 'then', 'when', 'if'.
formation: A (Sentence) + すると + B (Sentence)
ja: 電話をかけると、彼女が出ました。
romaji: Denwa wo kakeru to, kanojo ga demashita.
en: When I made the phone call, she answered.

meaning: Recalling something related to A; 'speaking of which', 'by the way', 'now that you mention it'.
formation: A + そういえば + B
ja: 映画。そういえば、彼は映画館で働いているんだ。
romaji: Eiga. Souieba, kare wa eigakan de hataraite irun da.
en: Movies. Speaking of which, he works at a movie theater.

meaning: Expresses 'therefore' or 'because of that'.
formation: A + そこで + B
ja: 明日は試験があります。そこで今晩勉強しようと思います。
romaji: Ashita wa shiken ga arimasu. Soko de konban benkyou shiyou to omoimasu.
en: There is an exam tomorrow. Therefore, I plan to study tonight.

meaning: Expressing 'that's what A is; in other words, B'.
formation: A (Statement)。それが B (Restatement or explanation of A)。
ja: 彼は勉強ができる。それが天才だ。
romaji: Kare wa benkyou ga dekiru. Sore ga tensai da.
en: He can study well. That's what a genius is.

meaning: Express a sequence of events; 'and then', 'so', 'because of that'.
formation: Sentence A +。それで+ Sentence B。
ja: 昨日は雨が降っていた。それで公園に行かなかった。
romaji: Kinou wa ame ga futte ita. Sore de kouen ni ikanakatta.
en: It was raining yesterday. So, I didn't go to the park.

meaning: Expresses 'even so', 'nevertheless', 'still', or 'but'; used to contrast two statements.
formation: A (situation) + 。それでも + B (action or thought)
ja: 今日は日曜日です。それでも、仕事に行かなければなりません。
romaji: Kyou wa nichiyoubi desu. Sore demo, shigoto ni ikanakereba narimasen.
en: Today is Sunday. Nevertheless, I have to go to work.

meaning: Express contrast or a contradiction between two situations or facts; 'even though', 'despite', 'but still'.
formation: A。それなのに B。
ja: 彼は頭がいい。それなのに、試験に落ちた。
romaji: Kare wa atama ga ii. Sore nanoni, shiken ni ochita.
en: He is smart. Despite that, he failed the exam.

pattern: A。それなら B。(A. Sore nara B.)
meaning: Express 'if that's the case, then'; used to show a logical consequence or decision based on a given situation.
formation: Situation A (sentence) + 。それなら + Situation B (sentence)
ja: 試験が近い。それなら、もっと勉強しなければならない。
romaji: Shiken ga chikai. Sore nara, motto benkyou shinakereba naranai.
en: The exam is coming soon. If that's the case, I must study more.

pattern: A それはそうと B。
meaning: Changing the topic; 'by the way', 'speaking of which'.
formation: Sentence A + それはそうと + Sentence B
ja: それはそうと、今日の天気はいいですね。
romaji: Sore wa sou to, kyou no tenki wa ii desu ne.
en: By the way, the weather is nice today, isn't it?

meaning: Expresses contrasting ideas or statements; 'but', 'however'.
formation: Sentence A + だが + Sentence B
ja: このレストランは値段が高い。だが、味はとてもいい。
romaji: Kono resutoran wa nedan ga takai. Daga, aji wa totemo ii.
en: This restaurant is expensive. But, the taste is very good.

meaning: Express contrast between two situations; 'although', 'but', 'however'.
formation: Sentence A + ただ + Sentence B
ja: 彼は頭がいい。ただ、努力はあまりしない。
romaji: Kare wa atama ga ii. Tada, doryoku wa amari shinai.
en: He is smart; however, he doesn't make much effort.

meaning: Adding a condition or exception to a statement; 'however', 'provided that', 'but only if'.
formation: Statement A + ただし + Condition B
ja: この部屋を使ってもいいです。ただし、使った後で掃除してください。
romaji: Kono heya wo tsukatte mo ii desu. Tadashi, tsukatta ato de souji shite kudasai.
en: You can use this room. However, please clean up after you use it.

meaning: Used to give a reason, express cause or bring up a topic; 'because', 'since', 'it's just that'.
formation: Verb-casual + だって、い-Adjective + だって、な-Adjective + だって、Noun + だって
ja: 暇だって、映画を見に行こうよ。
romaji: Hima datte, eiga wo mi ni ikou yo.
en: Since we are free, let's go watch a movie.

pattern: A。ちなみに B。(A. Chinamini B.)
meaning: Used to give additional information about the topic; 'by the way', 'incidentally'.
formation: A。ちなみに B。
ja: 今日は授業がありません。ちなみに、明日も休みです。
romaji: Kyou wa jugyou ga arimasen. Chinamini, asu mo yasumi desu.
en: There's no class today. By the way, tomorrow is also a day off.

meaning: Expresses the meaning 'if A, that means B' or 'A implies B'.
formation: A + ということは + B
ja: 彼女が泣いている。ということは何か悲しいことがあったに違いない。
romaji: Kanojo ga naite iru. To iu koto wa nanika kanashii koto ga atta ni chigainai.
en: She is crying. That means something sad must have happened.

pattern: A。というのは B。(Toiu no wa~)
meaning: Used to give an explanation or provide additional information for A; 'that is to say', 'in other words'.
formation: [Statement A]。というのは、[Statement B]。
ja: 彼は非常に疲れています。というのは、昨夜、車で遠くまで行ってきたためです。
romaji: Kare wa hijou ni tsukareteimasu. to iu no wa, sakuya, kuruma de tooku made itte kita tame desu.
en: He is very tired. That is to say, because he went far by car last night.

meaning: Provides additional information; 'moreover', 'besides', 'in addition'.
formation: A (sentence) + なお + B (sentence)
ja: 明日は休みです。なお、月曜日も休みです。
romaji: Ashita wa yasumi desu. Nao, getsuyoubi mo yasumi desu.
en: Tomorrow is a holiday. Moreover, Monday is also a holiday.

meaning: Express contrasting opinions or facts; 'although', 'but', 'however'.
formation: Clause A + もっとも + Clause B
ja: 彼は頭がいい。もっとも、勉強も大切だ。
romaji: Kare wa atama ga ii. Mottomo, benkyou mo taisetsu da.
en: He is smart. However, studying is also important.

pattern: A。要するに B。(A. Yousuru ni B.)
meaning: Expressing 'in short', 'in a nutshell', or 'to sum up' when restating or summarizing A as B.
formation: A。要するに B。
ja: このプロジェクトは成功しました。要するに、私たちのチームは素晴らしい仕事をしました。
romaji: Kono purojekuto wa seikou shimashita. Yousuru ni, watashitachi no chiimu wa subarashii shigoto o shimashita.
en: This project was successful. In short, our team did a great job.

meaning: Indicates the reason, cause, or condition for something; 'due to', 'regarding', 'per'.
formation: Noun + につき
ja: 試験につき、今日は静かにしてください。
romaji: Shiken ni tsuki, kyou wa shizuka ni shite kudasai.
en: Due to the exam, please be quiet today.

meaning: Expresses location or means; 'at', 'in', 'by', 'with'.
formation: Noun + にて
ja: 駅前広場にてイベントが開催されます。
romaji: Ekimae hiroba nite ibento ga kaisai saremasu.
en: An event will be held at the station square.

pattern: Noun の ことだから
meaning: Used to provide a reason or explanation based on one's knowledge about the noun; 'since', 'because', 'knowing'.
formation: Noun + のことだから
ja: 彼は料理が得意なのことだから、美味しい料理を作ってくれるでしょう。
romaji: Kare wa ryouri ga tokui na no koto dakara, oishii ryouri wo tsukutte kureru deshou.
en: Since he is good at cooking, he will probably make us delicious food.

meaning: Meaning 'starting with', 'including', 'not only... but also'.
formation: Noun + をはじめ
ja: 日本料理をはじめ、さまざまな料理がこのレストランで楽しめます。
romaji: Nihon ryouri wo hajime, samazama na ryouri ga kono resutoran de tanoshimemasu.
en: You can enjoy various dishes in this restaurant, starting with Japanese cuisine.

pattern: Noun を はじめとして
meaning: Expresses 'starting with', 'beginning with', or 'including'.
formation: Noun + をはじめとして
ja: 東京をはじめとして、日本にはたくさんの観光スポットがあります。
romaji: Toukyou wo hajimete shite, Nihon ni wa takusan no kankou supotto ga arimasu.
en: There are many tourist spots in Japan, starting with Tokyo.

pattern: Noun を はじめとする Noun
meaning: Indicates a representative example of a group; 'starting with', 'including', 'such as'.
formation: Noun1 を はじめとする Noun2
ja: 彼はフランス語をはじめとする外国語が話せる。
romaji: Kare wa furansugo wo hajimete suru gaikokugo ga hanaseru.
en: He can speak foreign languages, starting with French.

meaning: Concerning; with regard to; about
formation: Noun + を + めぐって
ja: 環境問題をめぐって、多くの議論が行われています。
romaji: Kankyou mondai wo megutte, ooku no giron ga okonawareteimasu.
en: Many discussions are held concerning environmental issues.

pattern: Noun を めぐる Noun
meaning: Indicate a situation or event revolving around a particular noun; 'concerning', 'regarding', 'pertaining to'.
formation: Noun1 + を + めぐる + Noun2
ja: この事件をめぐる議論が続いています。
romaji: Kono jiken wo meguru giron ga tsuduiteimasu.
en: The debate concerning this incident continues.

meaning: Based on; drawing from; using as a reference.
formation: Noun + をもとに
ja: この映画は実話をもとに作られました。
romaji: Kono eiga wa jitsuwa o moto ni tsukuraremashita.
en: This movie was made based on a true story.

pattern: Noun を もとにして
meaning: Based on; using; utilizing.
formation: Noun + をもとにして
ja: 彼の意見をもとにして、計画を変更しました。
romaji: Kare no iken wo moto ni shite, keikaku wo henkou shimashita.
en: Based on his opinion, we changed the plan.

meaning: Means 'without doing', 'not doing', or 'without happening'.
formation: Verb-stem + ことなく
ja: 彼女は泣くことなく帰ってしまいました。
romaji: Kanojo wa naku kotonaku kaette shimaimashita.
en: She went home without crying.

pattern: Verb ないことには Verb ない
meaning: Express that something cannot be done without meeting a certain condition.
formation: Verb-ない + ことには + Verb-ない
ja: 薬を飲まないことには、病気が治らない。
romaji: Kusuri o nomanai koto niwa, byouki ga naoranai.
en: Unless you take the medicine, the illness won't get better.

meaning: Expresses the outcome of a series of actions or events; 'in the end', 'finally', 'after'.
formation: Verb-て + あげく, Noun + の + あげく, い/な-Adjective + あげく
ja: 長い時間待ってあげく、電車が来なかった。
romaji: Nagai jikan matte ageku, densha ga konakatta.
en: After waiting a long time, in the end, the train didn't come.

meaning: Expresses the result of doing something excessively or beyond a certain point.
formation: Verb-ます stem + あまり, い-Adjective + あまり,  な-Adjective + のあまり, Noun + のあまり
ja: 昨日は疲れすぎたあまり、朝まで眠り続けました。
romaji: Kinou wa tsukaresugita amari, asa made nemuri tsuzukemashita.
en: Yesterday, I was so tired that I slept until morning.

meaning: Expresses doing something while a certain condition still holds; 'while', 'before', 'as long as'.
formation: Verb-casual + うちに, い-Adjective + いうちに, な-Adjective + なうちに, Noun + のうちに
ja: 元気なうちに、旅行を楽しんでください。
romaji: Genki na uchi ni, ryokou wo tanoshinde kudasai.
en: Enjoy traveling while you are healthy.

meaning: Expresses 'worth doing' for verbs.
formation: Verb-stem + がい
ja: この本を読むがいです。
romaji: Kono hon wo yomugai desu.
en: This book is worth reading.

meaning: Used to express that an effort is worth it or has value; 'to be worth the effort' or 'to pay off'.
formation: Verb-casual (stem) + かいがあって
ja: 毎日勉強するかいがあって、テストに合格した。
romaji: Mainichi benkyou suru kaiga atte, tesuto ni goukaku shita.
en: It was worth the effort of studying every day, as I passed the test.

meaning: Expresses the meaning of 'without worth', 'in vain', 'fruitless'.
formation: Verb-ます stem + かいもなく, Verb-dictionary form + かいもなく
ja: 長い間苦労したが、かいもなく失敗した。
romaji: Nagai aida kurou shita ga, kai mo naku shippai shita.
en: I struggled for a long time, but in the end, it was all in vain and I failed.

meaning: Indicates a process or action is 'in progress' or 'halfway'.
formation: Verb-stem + かける
ja: 彼女は食べかけのリンゴを置いて出かけた。
romaji: Kanojo wa tabekake no ringo wo oite dekaketa.
en: She left a partially eaten apple and went out.

meaning: Expresses that something tends to occur frequently or habitually.
formation: Verb-ますstem + がち, い-Adjective stem + がち, な-Adjective stem + がち
ja: 彼は風邪を引きがちです。
romaji: Kare wa kaze wo hikigachi desu.
en: He tends to catch a cold easily.

meaning: Expresses an action that occurs immediately after another action; 'as soon as', 'no sooner than', 'the moment'.
formation: Verb-casual + か + Verb-negative form + かのうちに
ja: 駅に着くか着かないかのうちに、雨が降り出した。
romaji: Eki ni tsuku ka tsukanai ka no uchi ni, ame ga furidashita.
en: The moment I arrived at the station, it started raining.

meaning: Express the likelihood of a negative outcome or consequence.
formation: Verb-stem + かねない
ja: 彼はそんなに無責任だから、約束を守れかねない。
romaji: Kare wa sonna ni musekinin dakara, yakusoku wo mamore kane nai.
en: He is so irresponsible that he might not keep his promise.

meaning: Express inability or impossibility of doing an action.
formation: Verb-ます stem + かねる
ja: その問題は難しいので、私には解決できかねます。
romaji: Sono mondai wa muzukashii node, watashi niwa kaiketsu dekikanemasu.
en: Since that problem is difficult, I cannot solve it.

meaning: Express a similarity or comparison; 'as if', 'like', 'as though'.
formation: Verb-casual + かのようだ, い-Adjective + かのようだ, な-Adjective + だかのようだ, Noun + だかのようだ
ja: 彼は犬が怖いかのようだ。
romaji: Kare wa inu ga kowai ka no you da.
en: He seems as if he is scared of dogs.

meaning: Used to express a dilemma or indecision between two options or actions
formation: Verb-ますform + か + Verb-ますform + まいか, い-Adjective + か + い-Adjective + であるまいか, な-Adjective + であるか + な-Adjective + であるまいか, Noun + であるか + Noun + であるまいか
ja: このプロジェクトを引き受けるか引き受けないまいか、まだ決めていない。
romaji: Kono purojekuto wo hikiukeru ka hikiukenai maika, mada kimeteinai.
en: I haven't decided whether to take on this project or not.

meaning: Express the emphasis on the reason; 'precisely because', 'it is precisely because'.
formation: Verb-casual + からこそ, い-Adjective + からこそ, な-Adjective + だからこそ, Noun + だからこそ
ja: 失敗したからこそ、成功の意味がわかる。
romaji: Shippai shita kara koso, seikou no imi ga wakaru.
en: It is precisely because I failed that I understand the meaning of success.

meaning: Expresses that something is exceptional, unusual or negative from a certain aspect or point.
formation: Noun + からして
ja: 彼の顔つきからして、何か悪いことがあったのだろう。
romaji: Kare no kaotsuki kara shite, nanika warui koto ga atta no darou.
en: From his facial expression, something bad must have happened.

meaning: Expresses a judgment or evaluation based on a certain standard; 'from this perspective', 'considering', 'judging from'.
formation: Noun + からすると
ja: 経験からすると、この仕事は難しいでしょう。
romaji: Keiken kara suru to, kono shigoto wa muzukashii deshou.
en: Considering their experience, this job might be difficult.

meaning: Expresses 'just because...doesn't mean' or 'even though...not necessarily'.
formation: Verb-casual + からといって, い-Adjective + からといって, な-Adjective + だからといって, Noun + だからといって
ja: 雨が降ったからといって、試合が中止になるわけではありません。
romaji: Ame ga futta kara to itte, shiai ga chuushi ni naru wake de wa arimasen.
en: Just because it rained doesn't mean the game will be canceled.

meaning: Expresses a range of time, space or quantities; 'from...to', 'between...and', 'over'.
formation: Noun 1 + から + Noun 2 + にかけて
ja: 午前９時から午後５時にかけて、仕事をしています。
romaji: Gozen kyu-ji kara gogo go-ji ni kakete, shigoto wo shiteimasu.
en: I work from 9 in the morning to 5 in the evening.

meaning: Express a sense of responsibility or determination; 'since', 'now that', 'if'.
formation: Noun + だ + からには, な-Adjective + だ + からには, い-Adjective + からには, Verb-casual + からには
ja: 試験に合格したからには、一所懸命働かなければならない。
romaji: Shiken ni goukaku shita kara niwa, isshokenmei hatarakanakereba naranai.
en: Since I passed the exam, I have to work hard.

meaning: Express a perspective or point of view; 'from the standpoint of', 'in terms of', 'from the perspective of'.
formation: Noun + から見ると
ja: 費用から見ると、このプランはお得です。
romaji: Hiyou kara miru to, kono puran wa otoku desu.
en: In terms of cost, this plan is a good deal.

meaning: Express a judgment or opinion based on a specific criterion; 'speaking from', 'in terms of', 'from the viewpoint of'.
formation: Noun + から言うと, Verb-casual + から言って, い-Adjective + から言って, な-Adjective + から言って
ja: 値段から言うと、この商品が最もお得です。
romaji: Nedan kara iuto, kono shouhin ga mottomo otoku desu.
en: Speaking from the viewpoint of price, this product is the best deal.

meaning: Used to criticize someone for doing something contrary to their nature or appearance.
formation: Verb-ますstem/い-Adjective + くせに, な-Adjective + なくせに, Noun + のくせに
ja: 彼はいつも遅刻してくるくせに、自分が待たされるのが嫌いだ。
romaji: Kare wa itsumo chikoku shite kuru kuse ni, jibun ga matasareru no ga kirai da.
en: He's always late, and yet he hates being kept waiting.

meaning: Indicates the reason or basis for something; 'because', 'since', 'due to'.
formation: Verb-casual + ことから, い-Adjective + ことから,な-Adjective + なことから, Noun + のことから
ja: 彼は毎日運動することから、体が丈夫です。
romaji: Kare wa mainichi undou suru koto kara, karada ga joubu desu.
en: Because he exercises every day, his body is strong.

meaning: Used to express feelings or emotions towards a situation, an action, or an outcome.
formation: Verb-casual + ことに, い-Adjective + ことに, な-Adjective + なことに, Noun + のことに
ja: 彼が急に帰国することに驚いた。
romaji: Kare ga kyuu ni kikoku suru koto ni odoroita.
en: I was surprised at him suddenly returning to his home country.

meaning: Expressing something is supposed to be or has been decided.
formation: Verb-plain form + ことになっている, い-Adjective + ことになっている, な-Adjective + だ + ことになっている, Noun + だ + ことになっている
ja: 日本では、左側を運転することになっています。
romaji: Nihon de wa, hidarigawa wo unten suru koto ni natte imasu.
en: In Japan, it is decided that we drive on the left side.

meaning: As long as, if only, providing that.
formation: Verb-casual + さえ + ば, い-Adjective + さえ + いい, な-Adjective + さえ + いい, Noun + さえ + いい
ja: お金さえあれば、幸せです。
romaji: O-kane sae areba, shiawase desu.
en: As long as I have money, I am happy.

meaning: To have no choice but to; cannot help but.
formation: Verb-ない form (Drop ない) + ざるを得ない
ja: この仕事は締め切りが近いので、残業するざるを得ない。
romaji: Kono shigoto wa shimekiri ga chikai no de, zangyou suru zaru wo enai.
en: Since the deadline for this job is near, I have no choice but to work overtime.

meaning: Cannot help but; cannot resist to; always.
formation: Verbs: Verb(ない-form) [remove ない] + ずにはいられない
ja: この曲を聞くと、歌わずにはいられない。
romaji: Kono kyoku o kiku to, utawazu ni wa irarenai.
en: When I hear this song, I cannot help but sing.

meaning: Express the unlikelihood of something happening; 'not likely', 'doesn't seem'.
formation: Verb-stem + そうにない, い-Adjective (drop い) + そうにない, な-Adjective + そうにない
ja: この雨が止むそうにない。
romaji: Kono ame ga yamu sou ni nai.
en: It doesn't seem like this rain will stop.

meaning: Express a sequence of events happening in quick succession or immediately following; 'as soon as', 'no sooner than'.
formation: Verb-たform + かと思ったら
ja: 電話をかけたかと思ったら、すぐに彼女が出た。
romaji: Denwa wo kaketa ka to omottara, sugu ni kanojo ga deta.
en: As soon as I made the phone call, she picked up.

meaning: Express 'since then' or 'after'; used to indicate that an action occurred once and has not been repeated or that a state has continued since a certain event or time.
formation: Verb-past + きり
ja: 彼は会社を辞めたきり、連絡がない。
romaji: Kare wa kaisha wo yameta kiri, renraku ga nai.
en: Since he quit the company, there's been no contact.

meaning: Expresses that something is as expected or deserves its reputation.
formation: Verb-casual + だけあって, い-Adjective + だけあって, な-Adjective + なだけあって, Noun + だけあって
ja: 彼は日本語が上手だけあって、日本人のように話すことができる。
romaji: Kare wa nihongo ga jouzu dake atte, nihonjin no you ni hanasu koto ga dekiru.
en: As expected of being good at Japanese, he can speak like a Japanese person.

meaning: Express a comparison; 'better than', 'at least', 'preferable'.
formation: Verb-casual + だけましだ, い-Adjective + だけましだ, な-Adjective + だけましだ, Noun + だけましだ
ja: 失敗するだけましだ。
romaji: Shippai suru dake mashi da.
en: At least it's better than failing.

meaning: Used to describe an action that has just been completed, often followed by a result or observation.
formation: Verb-past + ところ, い-Adjective-past + ところ, な-Adjective + だったところ, Noun + だったところ
ja: 掃除したところ、部屋がずっとキレイになりました。
romaji: Souji shita tokoro, heya ga zutto kirei ni narimashita.
en: I just finished cleaning, and the room has become much cleaner.

meaning: Express the moment something happens; 'as soon as', 'just when'.
formation: Verb-past + たとたん
ja: ドアを開けたとたん、雨が降り始めた。
romaji: Doa wo aketa totan, ame ga furihajimeta.
en: As soon as I opened the door, it started to rain.

meaning: Indicates that something is full of or covered with a certain characteristic or quality.
formation: Noun + だらけ
ja: 彼の部屋はゴミだらけだ。
romaji: Kare no heya wa gomi darake da.
en: His room is full of trash.

meaning: Expresses the impossibility or very low probability of something happening; 'no way', 'no chance', 'impossible'.
formation: Verb-negative stem + っこない
ja: こんなに雪が降っているんだから、学校に間に合っこない。
romaji: Kon'na ni yuki ga futteirun dakara, gakkou ni maniau kkonai.
en: With this much snow falling, there's no way we'll make it to school on time.

meaning: Shows two actions happening simultaneously; 'while', 'although'.
formation: Verb-stem + つつ
ja: 彼はテレビを見つつ、宿題をしていました。
romaji: Kare wa terebi wo mitsutsu, shukudai wo shiteimashita.
en: He was doing his homework while watching TV.

meaning: Expresses the ongoing process or gradual change.
formation: Verb-stem + つつある
ja: 地球温暖化は進行つつある。
romaji: Chikyuu ondanka wa shinkou tsutsu aru.
en: Global warming is in progress.

meaning: Express a continuous action or state; 'leave as is', 'non-stop', 'the whole time'.
formation: Verb-ます stem + っぱなし
ja: 窓を開けっぱなしにして、部屋が寒くなってしまった。
romaji: Mado wo akeppanashi ni shite, heya ga samuku natte shimatta.
en: I left the window open, and the room became cold.

meaning: Used to indicate that something has the appearance, characteristics, or behavior of something else.
formation: Noun + っぽい, Verb-casual + っぽい, い-Adjective + っぽい, な-Adjective + っぽい
ja: 彼女は大人っぽい服を着ている。
romaji: Kanojo wa otonappoi fuku o kite iru.
en: She is wearing clothes that look mature.

meaning: Expresses that one cannot afford to do something; 'can't keep on', 'unable to continue'.
formation: Verb-て form + いられない
ja: こんなに忙しいのに、無理に遊んでいられない。
romaji: Konna ni isogashii noni, muri ni asonde irarenai.
en: I'm so busy that I can't afford to play around.

meaning: Expresses that something cannot be endured, tolerated, or is uncontrollable.
formation: Verb-てform + かなわない
ja: この暑さにはもう我慢してかなわない。
romaji: Kono atsusa ni wa mou gaman shite kanawanai.
en: I cannot endure this heat anymore.

meaning: Indicates that something cannot be done before a certain action is completed; 'not until', 'only after'.
formation: Verb-casual + てからでないと
ja: 宿題をしてからでないと、遊びに行けません。
romaji: Shukudai wo shite kara denai to, asobi ni ikemasen.
en: You cannot go play until after you have done your homework.

meaning: Emphasizes the condition; 'only when', 'precisely because'
formation: Verb-てform + こそ, い-adjective + くてこそ, な-adjective + でこそ, Noun + でこそ
ja: 勉強してこそ、テストに合格します。
romaji: Benkyou shite koso, tesuto ni goukaku shimasu.
en: Only when you study will you pass the test.

meaning: Can't be helped; inevitable.
formation: Verb-te form + でしょうがない, い-Adjective + でしょうがない, な-Adjective + でしょうがない, Noun + でしょうがない
ja: 雨が降っているから、家にいるでしょうがない。
romaji: Ame ga futteiru kara, ie ni iru deshou ga nai.
en: Since it's raining, it's inevitable that we have to stay home.

meaning: Express strong feelings or emotions; 'can't stand', 'can't resist', 'extremely'.
formation: Verb-てform + たまらない, い-Adjective + でたまらない, な-Adjective + でたまらない, Noun + でたまらない
ja: この暑さでたまらない。
romaji: Kono atsusa de tamaranai.
en: This heat is unbearable.

meaning: Indicates a strong feeling or emotion; 'I cannot help but', 'I cannot stand'.
formation: い-Adjective (negative stem) + でならない, な-Adjective + でなならない
ja: 彼の演技が上手すぎて、感動でならない。
romaji: Kare no engi ga jouzu sugite, kandou denaranai.
en: His acting is so good, I cannot help but be moved.

meaning: Cannot afford to only do something; cannot always rely on
formation: Verb-てform + でばかりはいられない
ja: いつも助けてもらってばかりはいられない。
romaji: Itsumo tasukete moratte bakari wa irarenai.
en: I can't always rely on others to help me.

meaning: Used to show a strong assertion or emphasis on one's opinion; 'isn't it', 'aren't you', 'right'.
formation: Noun + ではないか, い-Adjective + ではないか, な-Adjective + ではないか, Verb-casual + ではないか
ja: 彼は優秀な学生ではないか。
romaji: Kare wa yuushuu na gakusei de wa nai ka.
en: He is an excellent student, isn't he?

meaning: Express prohibition; 'must not', 'cannot', 'should not'.
formation: Verb-て form + はならない
ja: ここでタバコを吸ってはならない。
romaji: Koko de tabako o sutte wa naranai.
en: You must not smoke here.

meaning: Express the extent someone goes in order to achieve something; 'to the point of', 'even', 'so far as to'.
formation: Verb-てform + まで
ja: 彼は試験に合格するために、徹夜してまで勉強しました。
romaji: Kare wa shiken ni goukaku suru tame ni, tetsuya shite made benkyou shimashita.
en: He studied to the point of staying up all night in order to pass the exam.

meaning: Expresses that something is natural or expected.
formation: Verb-て form + 当然だ
ja: 彼は毎日勉強しているから、試験に合格して当然だ。
romaji: Kare wa mainichi benkyou shiteiru kara, shiken ni goukaku shite touzen da.
en: Since he studies every day, it's natural that he passes the exam.

meaning: Expressing a general rule or common sense.
formation: Sentence + というものだ
ja: 若者の熱情は尊敬するに値するというものだ。
romaji: Wakamono no netsujou wa sonkei suru ni atai suru to iu mono da.
en: The passion of young people is something that deserves respect.

meaning: Express a strong desire or wish for something to be possible.
formation: Verb-negative form (〜ない) + ものか
ja: どうにかこの仕事を終わらせないものか。
romaji: Dou ni ka kono shigoto wo owarasenai mono ka.
en: Is there no way to finish this job somehow?

meaning: Express doing as instructed or how something is; 'as', 'according to', 'following'.
formation: Verb-casual + とおり, い-Adjective + とおり, な-Adjective + だとおり, Noun + だとおり
ja: 先生が言ったとおりに宿題をしました。
romaji: Sensei ga itta toori ni shukudai wo shimashita.
en: I did my homework as the teacher said.

meaning: Used to list examples or express uncertainty; 'such as', 'like', 'or something like that'.
formation: Verb-casual + とか, い-Adjective + とか, な-Adjective + だとか, Noun + だとか
ja: 休日は映画を見るとか、買い物に行くとかして過ごします。
romaji: Kyuujitsu wa eiga wo miru to ka, kaimono ni iku to ka shite sugoshimasu.
en: On holidays, I spend my time doing things like watching movies or going shopping.

meaning: Express a specific point in time or state; 'when', 'just about', 'in the middle of'.
formation: Verb-casual + ところ, い-Adjective + ところ, な-Adjective + なところ, Noun + のところ
ja: 出かけるところです。
romaji: Dekakeru tokoro desu.
en: I am just about to leave.

meaning: Express 'far from', 'not just', 'not only', or 'to say nothing of'.
formation: Verb-casual + どころか, い-Adjective + どころか, な-Adjective + どころか, Noun + どころか
ja: 彼は歌が上手どころか、プロの歌手みたいだ。
romaji: Kare wa uta ga jouzu dokoroka, puro no utaite mitai da.
en: Far from just being good at singing, he is like a professional singer.

meaning: Not the time/place for; far from; not merely
formation: Verb-casual, past + どころではない, い-Adjective + どころではない, な-Adjective + どころではない, Noun + どころではない
ja: 彼の失敗を笑うどころではない。我々も同じように失敗している。
romaji: Kare no shippai wo warau dokoro de wa nai. Wareware mo onaji you ni shippai shiteiru.
en: It's not the time to laugh at his mistakes. We're making the same mistakes ourselves.

meaning: Express a hypothetical situation; 'if', 'suppose', 'assuming'.
formation: Verb-casual + としたら, い-Adjective + としたら,な-Adjective + だとしたら, Noun + だとしたら
ja: 明日雨が降るとしたら、傘を持って行きましょう。
romaji: Ashita ame ga furu to shitara, kasa wo motte ikimashou.
en: If it rains tomorrow, let's bring an umbrella.

meaning: Even if, despite, although
formation: Verb-casual + としても, い-Adjective + としても, な-Adjective + だとしても, Noun + だとしても
ja: 雨が降っても、レースは開催されます。
romaji: Ame ga futte mo, reesu wa kaisai saremasu.
en: Even if it rains, the race will be held.

meaning: Expresses 'together with' or 'along with'; used to describe two events or actions happening simultaneously or in parallel.
formation: Verb-casual + とともに, い-Adjective + とともに, な-Adjective + とともに, Noun + とともに
ja: 彼が来るとともに、パーティーが始まりました。
romaji: Kare ga kuru to tomoni, paatii ga hajimarimashita.
en: The party started as soon as he arrived.

meaning: Expresses that something is not necessarily true; 'not always', 'not necessarily'.
formation: Verb-casual + とは限らない, い-Adjective + とは限らない, な-Adjective + だとは限らない, Noun + だとは限らない
ja: いつも勉強しているとは限らない。
romaji: Itsumo benkyou shite iru to wa kagiranai.
en: It's not always true that I'm studying.

meaning: Express that something is not impossible, meaning it is possible or could be done.
formation: Verb-ないform + ことはない
ja: 彼が来ないことはない。
romaji: Kare ga konai koto wa nai.
en: It's not that he won't come (it's possible that he will come).

meaning: Used to express an action or state is 'not impossible', but emphasizes reluctance or doubt.
formation: Verb-ないForm + こともない, い-adjective + こともない
ja: この問題を解くことはできないこともないけど、難しいです。
romaji: Kono mondai wo toku koto wa dekinai koto mo nai kedo, muzukashii desu.
en: It's not that I can't solve this problem, but it's difficult.

meaning: Cannot help but; cannot avoid; unable to refrain from.
formation: Verb-ない form + ではいられない or じゃいられない
ja: この映画はとても感動的で、泣かないではいられなかった。
romaji: Kono eiga wa totemo kandouteki de, nakanai de wa irarenakatta.
en: This movie was so touching, I couldn't help but cry.

meaning: Express doing two things simultaneously or at the same time.
formation: Verb-stem + ながら
ja: テレビを見ながら宿題をしています。
romaji: Terebi wo minagara shukudai wo shiteimasu.
en: I am doing my homework while watching TV.

meaning: Expresses the meaning of 'at the time of', 'in', 'on', or 'upon'.
formation: Noun + にあたり
ja: 入学にあたり、必要な書類を準備してください。
romaji: Nyūgaku ni atari, hitsuyōna shorui wo junbi shite kudasai.
en: Please prepare the necessary documents upon entering the school.

meaning: Indicates the place, time, or context where an action or event occurs; 'in', 'at', 'on', 'regarding'.
formation: Noun + において
ja: この大学において、英語のクラスが一番人気があります。
romaji: Kono daigaku ni oite, eigo no kurasu ga ichiban ninki ga arimasu.
en: In this university, English classes are the most popular.

meaning: Regardless of; irrespective of; despite.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + にかかわらず, い-Adjective + にかかわらず, な-Adjective + にかかわらず, Noun + にかかわらず
ja: 天気にかかわらず、今日の試合は行われます。
romaji: Tenki ni kakawarazu, kyou no shiai wa okonawaremasu.
en: The game today will be held, regardless of the weather.

meaning: Indicates a specific area or aspect in which someone or something excels.
formation: Noun + にかけては
ja: 料理の腕前にかけては、彼女は誰にも負けません。
romaji: Ryouri no udemae ni kakete wa, kanojo wa dare ni mo makemasen.
en: When it comes to cooking skills, she is second to none.

meaning: Expresses a natural consequence or a change that occurs according to something else; 'as', 'with', 'in accordance with'.
formation: Noun + にしたがって
ja: 成長にしたがって、この植物の葉が大きくなります。
romaji: Seichou ni shitagatte, kono shokubutsu no ha ga ookiku narimasu.
en: As it grows, the leaves of this plant become larger.

meaning: Express a point of view; 'from the perspective of', 'if I were'.
formation: Noun + にしたら, Pronoun + にしたら
ja: 彼にしたら、早く帰りたいだろう。
romaji: Kare ni shitara, hayaku kaeritai darou.
en: From his perspective, he probably wants to go home early.

meaning: Expresses 'either way', 'in any case', 'be it...', used when presenting two alternatives.
formation: Verb-てしろ + にしろ, い-Adjective + にしろ, な-Adjective + にしろ, Noun + にしろ
ja: 行くにしろ行かないにしろ、早く決めてください。
romaji: Iku ni shiro ikanai ni shiro, hayaku kimete kudasai.
en: Either way, whether you go or not, please decide quickly.

meaning: Expresses 'whenever', 'each time', 'whether...or'.
formation: Verb-casual + につけ, い-Adjective + につけ, な-Adjective + につけ, Noun + につけ
ja: 外国へ行くにつけ、勉強するにつけ、言葉の壁にぶつかる。
romaji: Gaikoku e iku ni tsuke, benkyou suru ni tsuke, kotoba no kabe ni butsukaru.
en: Whether I go abroad or study, I always encounter language barriers.

meaning: Expresses the idea that as one thing changes, so does another; 'as', 'along with', 'while'.
formation: Verb-ますstem + につれて, い-Adjective(-い) + く + につれて, な-Adjective + につれて, Noun + につれて
ja: 年を取るにつれて、健康に気をつけなければなりません。
romaji: Toshi wo toru ni tsurete, kenkou ni ki wo tsukenakereba narimasen.
en: As you get older, you have to pay more attention to your health.

meaning: Expresses 'along with' or 'as a result of'; indicates that one event occurs along with another.
formation: Noun (event) + にともなって, Verb-casual + にともなって
ja: 人口が増えるにともなって、交通渋滞も悪化しています。
romaji: Jinkou ga fueru ni tomonatte, koutsuu juutai mo akka shiteimasu.
en: As the population increases, traffic congestion is also getting worse.

meaning: Express that something is 'nothing but' or 'none other than'.
formation: Verb-plain + にほかならない, い-Adjective + にほかならない, な-Adjective + にほかならない, Noun + にほかならない
ja: 彼の成功は努力にほかならない。
romaji: Kare no seikou wa doryoku ni hoka naranai.
en: His success is nothing but hard work.

meaning: Expresses 'despite', 'in spite of' or 'even though'.
formation: Verb-て form + にもかかわらず, い-Adjective (drop い) + くてもかかわらず, な-Adjective + であるにもかかわらず, Noun + であるにもかかわらず
ja: 忙しいにもかかわらず、彼は毎日運動しています。
romaji: Isogashii ni mo kakawarazu, kare wa mainichi undou shiteimasu.
en: Despite being busy, he exercises every day.

meaning: Indicates the reason, method, or means by which something happens; 'by', 'through', 'due to'.
formation: Noun + により, Verb + により
ja: この事故は運転手の不注意により起こりました。
romaji: Kono jiko wa untenshu no fuchuui ni yori okorimashita.
en: This accident occurred due to the driver's carelessness.

meaning: Indicates a range or extent; 'over', 'throughout', 'across'.
formation: Noun + にわたって
ja: 彼女は一年にわたって日本語を勉強しました。
romaji: Kanojo wa ichinen ni watatte nihongo wo benkyou shimashita.
en: She studied Japanese for over a year.

meaning: Express an action or event that occurs before another; 'before', 'prior to', 'preceding'.
formation: Verb[ます-stem] + に先立ち
ja: 会議に先立ち、資料を確認しましょう。
romaji: Kaigi ni sakidachi, shiryou wo kakunin shimashou.
en: Before the meeting, let's check the materials.

meaning: Contrary to, against, in spite of
formation: Noun + に反して
ja: 天気予報に反して、今日は雨が降っている。
romaji: Tenki yohou ni hanshite, kyou wa ame ga futte iru.
en: Contrary to the weather forecast, it is raining today.

meaning: Based on, according to, depending on
formation: Noun + に基づいて
ja: 研究結果に基づいて、新しい治療法が開発されました。
romaji: Kenkyuu kekka ni motozuite, atarashii chiryouhou ga kaihatsu sareました。
en: A new treatment method was developed based on the research results.

meaning: Expresses 'toward', 'against', 'in contrast to', or 'in response to'.
formation: Noun + に対して
ja: 日本の文化に対して尊敬の念を持っています。
romaji: Nihon no bunka ni taishite sonkei no nen wo motteimasu.
en: I have a sense of respect towards Japanese culture.

meaning: Responding to; living up to; meeting.
formation: Noun + に応えて
ja: お客様の要望に応えて、新しいメニューを作りました。
romaji: Okyaku-sama no youbou ni kotaete, atarashii menyuu o tsukurimashita.
en: Responding to the customers' requests, we created a new menu.

meaning: In accordance with, depending on, in response to.
formation: Noun + に応じて
ja: 仕事の量に応じて給料が変わります。
romaji: Shigoto no ryou ni oujite kyuuryou ga kawarimasu.
en: The salary changes depending on the amount of work.

meaning: Express certainty; 'it is obvious', 'it must be', 'no doubt'.
formation: Verb-casual + に決まっている, い-Adjective + に決まっている, な-Adjective + だに決まっている, Noun + だに決まっている
ja: こんなに暑い日に運動したら、汗をかくに決まっている。
romaji: Konna ni atsui hi ni undou shitara, ase wo kaku ni kimatte iru.
en: It's obvious that you'll sweat if you exercise on such a hot day.

meaning: Along with; in accordance with; following
formation: Noun + に沿って
ja: 川に沿って歩いていくと、橋が見えてきます。
romaji: Kawa ni sotte aruite iku to, hashi ga miete kimasu.
en: If you walk along the river, you will see a bridge.

meaning: Expresses that something is 'just' or 'nothing more than'; 'merely', 'only', 'simply'.
formation: Verb-casual + に過ぎない, い-Adjective + に過ぎない, な-Adjective + に過ぎない, Noun + に過ぎない
ja: 彼の失敗はミスに過ぎない。
romaji: Kare no shippai wa misu ni suginai.
en: His failure is nothing more than a mistake.

meaning: Indicates that something is related to or influenced by a certain matter or factor; 'concerning', 'in connection with', 'regarding'.
formation: Verb-casual + に関わって, い-Adjective + に関わって, な-Adjective + に関わって, Noun + に関わって
ja: 試験の内容に関わって、先生に質問があります。
romaji: Shiken no naiyou ni kakawatte, sensei ni shitsumon ga arimasu.
en: I have a question for the teacher regarding the content of the exam.

meaning: Expresses limitation; 'only', 'limited to', 'exclusive to'.
formation: Noun + に限り
ja: 今日に限り、この商品が半額です。
romaji: Kyou ni kagiri, kono shouhin ga hangaku desu.
en: Today only, this product is half price.

meaning: Used to express the moment or the occasion of an action; 'at the time of', 'upon', 'when'.
formation: Noun + に際して
ja: 卒業式に際して、校長先生がスピーチをします。
romaji: Sotsugyoushiki ni saishite, kouchou sensei ga supiichi wo shimasu.
en: Upon the graduation ceremony, the principal gives a speech.

meaning: Expresses obligation or necessity; 'must', 'have to', 'need to'.
formation: Verb-ない form + ねばならない
ja: 試験に合格するために、もっと勉強しなければならない。
romaji: Shiken ni goukaku suru tame ni, motto benkyou shinakereba naranai.
en: To pass the exam, I have to study more.

meaning: Not only... but also; as well as.
formation: Verb-casual + のみならず + (も), い-Adjective + のみならず + (も), な-Adjective + のみならず + (も), Noun + のみならず + (も)
ja: 彼は英語のみならず、フランス語も話せます。
romaji: Kare wa eigo no minarazu, furansugo mo hanasemasu.
en: He can speak not only English but also French.

meaning: Express that something is understandable or reasonable.
formation: Verb-casual + のももっともだ, い-Adjective + のももっともだ,な-Adjective + なのももっともだ, Noun + なのももっともだ
ja: 彼が緊張するのももっともだ。
romaji: Kare ga kinchou suru no mo mottomo da.
en: It's understandable that he is nervous.

meaning: Indicates 'on the basis of', 'in terms of', or 'from the standpoint of'.
formation: Noun or Phrase + の上では
ja: 効率の上では、この方法が最適です。
romaji: Kouritsu no ue de wa, kono houhou ga saiteki desu.
en: In terms of efficiency, this method is the best.

meaning: Under the context or condition of; under.
formation: Verb-casual + の下で, い-Adjective + の下で, な-Adjective + の下で, Noun + の下で
ja: 先生の下で勉強するのはとても楽しいです。
romaji: Sensei no shita de benkyou suru no wa totemo tanoshii desu.
en: Studying under the teacher is very enjoyable.

meaning: Expresses 'not only... but also'; emphasizing the extent of something.
formation: Noun/Verb/Adjective + ばかりか + Noun/Verb/Adjective + も
ja: 彼はかわいいばかりか賢いもです。
romaji: Kare wa kawaii bakari ka kashikoi mo desu.
en: He is not only cute but also smart.

meaning: Express a continuing state or negative tendency; 'just', 'only', 'always'.
formation: Verb-てform + ばかりだ, い-Adjective + ばかりだ, な-Adjective + ばかりだ, Noun + ばかりだ
ja: 彼は文句を言ってばかりだ。
romaji: Kare wa monku wo itte bakari da.
en: He is always complaining.

meaning: Express undesired situation or result caused by something; 'simply because', 'due to', 'on account of'.
formation: Verb-casual + ばかりに, い-Adjective + ばかりに, な-Adjective + なばかりに, Noun + なばかりに
ja: 雨が降ったばかりに、試合が中止になりました。
romaji: Ame ga futta bakari ni, shiai ga chuushi ni narimashita.
en: Simply because it rained, the game was cancelled.

meaning: Not necessarily true that if A, then B.
formation: Verb-ば form + というものでもない
ja: 高いものがいいものばかりではない。
romaji: Takai mono ga ii mono bakari de wa nai.
en: Expensive things are not always good.

meaning: Used to compare elements in a sentence with 'as for'.
formation: Noun1 はともかく Noun2 は
ja: デザインはともかく、機能はこの携帯電話が一番です。
romaji: Dezain wa tomokaku, kinou wa kono keitai denwa ga ichiban desu.
en: As for design, the functionality of this mobile phone is the best.

meaning: Expresses that although the first item is somewhat understandable or acceptable, the second item is not.
formation: Noun1 + はまだしも + Noun2
ja: 失敗するのはまだしも、やらないで後悔する方がつらい。
romaji: Shippai suru no wa mada shimo, yaranai de koukai suru hou ga tsurai.
en: Failing is one thing, but it's even harder to not try and regret it later.

meaning: Expressing that something is obvious or not only, but also.
formation: Noun1 + はもとより, Noun2 + も
ja: 英語はもとより、スペイン語も勉強しています。
romaji: Eigo wa moto yori, supeingo mo benkyou shiteimasu.
en: Not only English, but I'm also studying Spanish.

meaning: Leaving aside, excluding
formation: Noun + は抜きにして
ja: 値段は抜きにして、味は美味しい。
romaji: Nedan wa nuki ni shite, aji wa oishii.
en: Leaving aside the price, the taste is delicious.

meaning: Express an action that should not be done; 'should not', 'ought not to'.
formation: Verb-ますstem + べき + ではない
ja: 遅れる理由がないなら、遅れるべきではありません。
romaji: Okureru riyuu ga nai nara, okureru beki dewa arimasen.
en: If there is no reason to be late, you should not be late.

meaning: Express a negative conjecture or determination; 'probably not' or 'I will not'.
formation: Verb-ますstem + まい
ja: 彼は今晩来るまい。
romaji: Kare wa konban kuru mai.
en: He probably won't come tonight.

meaning: Express doing something until a certain time or condition; 'until', 'to'.
formation: Verb-てform + まで
ja: 9時まで働いて、その後休憩しました。
romaji: Kuji made hataraite, sono ato kyūkei shimashita.
en: I worked until 9 o'clock, and then took a break.

meaning: Act according to; left as it is; unchanged.
formation: Verb-て + まま, い-Adjective + のまま, な-Adjective + なまま, Noun + のまま
ja: 子供が寝ているままに、静かに部屋を出ました。
romaji: Kodomo ga neteiru mama ni, shizuka ni heya wo demashita.
en: I quietly left the room while the child was sleeping.

meaning: Express indifference or disregard; 'without hesitating', 'without worrying about'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + もかまわず, Noun + もかまわず
ja: 彼は周りの人もかまわず、大声で話しました。
romaji: Kare wa mawari no hito mo kamawazu, oogoe de hanashimashita.
en: Without worrying about the people around him, he talked loudly.

meaning: Definitely not; no way; no chance.
formation: Verb(volitional) + ものか, い-Adjective + ものか
ja: そんなこと、僕がやりたいものか。
romaji: Sonna koto, boku ga yaritai mono ka.
en: No way I want to do such a thing.

meaning: Express a feeling that something should be done or is expected; 'there is a need', 'there is a tendency'.
formation: Verb-casual + ものがある, い-Adjective + ことがある
ja: 彼はいつも遅刻するものがある。
romaji: Kare wa itsumo chikoku suru mono ga aru.
en: He has a tendency to be late all the time.

meaning: Expresses something natural or normal; 'should', 'ought to'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + ものだ, な-Adjective + なものだ, Noun + のものだ
ja: 若い時はたくさん遊ぶものだ。
romaji: Wakai toki wa takusan asobu mono da.
en: It is natural to play a lot when you are young.

meaning: Express the reason or cause for something; 'because', 'since', 'due to'.
formation: Verb-plain + ものだから, い-Adjective + ものだから, な-Adjective + なものだから, Noun + なものだから
ja: 試験が近いものだから、毎日勉強しています。
romaji: Shiken ga chikai mono dakara, mainichi benkyou shiteimasu.
en: Because the exam is near, I study every day.

meaning: Expresses 'not (something) to be done', 'should not', 'must not'.
formation: Verb-てform + ものではない
ja: そんなことを言うものではありません。
romaji: Sonna koto wo iu mono dewa arimasen.
en: You should not say such a thing.

meaning: Express a conditional wish; 'if only' or 'if possible'.
formation: Verb-casual + ものなら, い-Adjective + ものなら, な-Adjective + なものなら, Noun + のなら
ja: 時間があるものなら、この本を全部読みたい。
romaji: Jikan ga aru mono nara, kono hon wo zenbu yomitai.
en: If only I had time, I would like to read this whole book.

meaning: Indicates a contrast or contradiction between two clauses; 'although', 'but', 'even though'.
formation: Verb-casual + ものの, い-Adjective + ものの, な-Adjective + なものの, Noun + のものの
ja: 早起きしたものの、バスに間に合わなかった。
romaji: Hayaoki shita mono no, basu ni maniawanakatta.
en: Even though I got up early, I didn't make it in time for the bus.

meaning: Expressing that if one thing increases, the other also increases; 'the more, the more'.
formation: Noun/Verb-て/Adjective + も + Noun/Verb-て/Adjective + ば + も
ja: 勉強すればするも、成績が上がるでしょう。
romaji: Benkyou sureba suru mo, seiseki ga agaru deshou.
en: The more you study, the better your grades will be.

meaning: Indicates 'as good as', 'virtually', or 'practically'.
formation: Verb-て form + も同然だ, い-Adjective + くても同然だ, な-Adjective + であっても同然だ, Noun + であっても同然だ
ja: この運動は簡単で覚えることも同然だ。
romaji: Kono undou wa kantan de oboeru koto mo douzen da.
en: This exercise is as good as easy to remember.

meaning: Express various things or actions; 'and', 'such as', 'things like'.
formation: Verb-casual + やら, い-Adjective + やら, な-Adjective + だやら, Noun + やら
ja: 宿題やら掃除やらやることがたくさんある。
romaji: Shukudai yara souji yara yaru koto ga takusan aru.
en: There are many things to do, such as homework and cleaning.

meaning: Expresses that something cannot be helped or is unavoidable.
formation: Verb-ます stem + ようがない, い-Adjective (remove い) + さがない
ja: この仕事は終わりが見えないので、疲れるようがない。
romaji: Kono shigoto wa owari ga mienai node, tsukareru you ga nai.
en: Since there is no end in sight for this job, it's inevitable to get tired.

meaning: Express that there is no other choice/alternative; 'have no choice but', 'nothing but', 'cannot do anything but'.
formation: Verb-Te form + よりほかない, い-Adjective-Te form(+の) + よりほかない, な-Adjective + で + よりほかない, Noun + で + よりほかない
ja: 試験が近いので、勉強するよりほかない。
romaji: Shiken ga chikai node, benkyou suru yori hoka nai.
en: Since the exam is near, there is no choice but to study.

meaning: Expresses 'there's no way' or 'it's impossible', indicating a high degree of certainty.
formation: Verb-casual + わけがない, い-Adjective + わけがない, な-Adjective + なわけがない, Noun + のわけがない
ja: 彼が怪我をしたから、試合に勝てるわけがない。
romaji: Kare ga kega wo shita kara, shiai ni kateru wake ga nai.
en: He got injured, so there's no way he can win the match.

meaning: Express a logical conclusion or reason; 'it means', 'no wonder', 'the reason is'.
formation: Verb-casual + わけだ, い-Adjective + わけだ, な-Adjective + なわけだ, Noun + のわけだ
ja: 彼女が遅れたのは、電車が遅れたわけだ。
romaji: Kanojo ga okureta no wa, densha ga okureta wake da.
en: The reason she was late is that the train was delayed.

meaning: Not necessarily; it doesn't mean that.
formation: Verb-plain + わけではない, い-Adjective + わけではない, な-Adjective + だわけではない, Noun + だわけではない
ja: 彼が勉強しないわけではないが、成績があまり良くない。
romaji: Kare ga benkyou shinai wake dewa nai ga, seiseki ga amari yoku nai.
en: It's not that he doesn't study, but his grades are not very good.

meaning: Expresses that one cannot afford to do something; 'cannot', 'must not', 'not allowed to'.
formation: Verb-casual + わけにはいかない
ja: 試験が近いから、遊ぶわけにはいかない。
romaji: Shiken ga chikai kara, asobu wake ni wa ikanai.
en: Since the exam is approaching, I can't afford to play.

meaning: indicates that something serves as a starting point or trigger for another event or action.
formation: Noun + をきっかけに
ja: 結婚をきっかけに、彼は真剣に仕事を頑張り始めました。
romaji: Kekkon wo kikkake ni, kare wa shinken ni shigoto wo ganbarihajimemashita.
en: As a result of getting married, he began to work more seriously.

meaning: Express 'as', 'in the capacity of', or 'taking for'.
formation: Noun1 + を + Noun2 + として
ja: 彼は教師を職業としています。
romaji: Kare wa kyoushi wo shokugyou toshiteimasu.
en: He works as a teacher.

meaning: Centering around, mainly, focusing on.
formation: Noun + を中心に
ja: このイベントは音楽を中心に楽しまれています。
romaji: Kono ibento wa ongaku wo chuushin ni tanoshimarete imasu.
en: This event is mainly enjoyed for its music.

meaning: Regardless of; irrespective of.
formation: Noun1 + ～を問わず + Noun2
ja: このイベントは、年齢を問わず、誰でも参加できます。
romaji: Kono ibento wa, nenrei wo towazu, daredemo sanka dekimasu.
en: This event is open to everyone, regardless of age.

meaning: To express that something is done with a certain feeling, intention, or emotion.
formation: Feeling/emotion/intention Noun + を + 込めて + Verb
ja: 愛を込めて料理を作りました。
romaji: Ai wo komete ryouri wo tsukurimashita.
en: I cooked the meal with love.

meaning: Expresses 'through', 'throughout', or 'during'.
formation: Noun + を通じて
ja: インターネットを通じて友達と連絡を取ります。
romaji: Intaanetto wo tsuujite tomodachi to renraku wo torimasu.
en: I keep in touch with my friends through the internet.

meaning: To rely on or depend on something or someone.
formation: Noun + を頼りに
ja: 彼女は地図を頼りに旅行をしている。
romaji: Kanojo wa chizu wo tayori ni ryokou wo shite iru.
en: She is traveling relying on a map.

meaning: Indicates that while one action is happening, another action or situation is simultaneously occurring or is in contrast.
formation: Verbal Noun (Verb Stem) + 一方だ, Verb Stem + 一方, い-Adjective + 一方, な-Adjective + である一方
ja: 技術が進化する一方、生活が忙しくなっている。
romaji: Gijutsu ga shinka suru ippou, seikatsu ga isogashiku natte iru.
en: While technology advances, life is getting busier.

meaning: Expresses that a situation or condition is increasingly getting more and more.
formation: Verb-ますstem + 一方だ, い-Adjective (remove い) + 一方だ, な-Adjective + で + 一方だ
ja: 世界の人口は増える一方だ。
romaji: Sekai no jinkou wa fueru ippou da.
en: The world's population is continually increasing.

meaning: Used to express that something is done after or on the grounds of something else; 'after', 'on the basis of'.
formation: Verb-ますstem + 上で, Noun + の上で
ja: 調査を行った上で、結論を出しましょう。
romaji: Chousa wo okonatta ue de, ketsuron wo dashimashou.
en: Let's draw a conclusion after conducting the investigation.

meaning: Express 'in addition to', 'besides', 'not only... but also'.
formation: Verb-plain +  上に, い-Adjective +  上に, な-Adjective + な上に, Noun + の上に
ja: 彼は頭がいい上に、スポーツも得意です。
romaji: Kare wa atama ga ii ue ni, supo-tsu mo tokui desu.
en: In addition to being smart, he is also good at sports.

meaning: Now that; since; once
formation: Verb-casual + 上は, い-Adjective + 上は, な-Adjective + な上は, Noun + の上は
ja: 試験に合格した上は、パーティーを開こう。
romaji: Shiken ni goukaku shita ue wa, paatii wo hirakou.
en: Now that I have passed the exam, let's have a party.

meaning: Expresses 'since' or 'as long as' in a conditional context.
formation: Verb-casual + 以上, い-Adjective + 以上, な-Adjective + な以上, Noun + の以上
ja: 彼は忙しい以上、手伝いに行っても無駄だろう。
romaji: Kare wa isogashii ijou, tetsudai ni itte mo muda darou.
en: Since he is busy, it would be pointless to go help him.

meaning: Indicates something happening 'since', 'ever since', or 'after' a particular time.
formation: Verb-past + 以来, い-Adjective + 以来, Noun + 以来
ja: 卒業以来、彼女に会っていない。
romaji: Sotsugyou irai, kanojo ni atte inai.
en: I haven't seen her since we graduated.

meaning: To do something completely or thoroughly.
formation: Verb-stem + 切る
ja: 彼は試験勉強をがんばり切るつもりだ。
romaji: Kare wa shiken benkyou o ganbarikiru tsumori da.
en: He intends to study hard for the exam, doing his best.

meaning: Express contrast between two aspects; 'on the one hand', 'on the other hand'.
formation: Verb-casual + 反面, い-Adjective + 反面, な-Adjective + である反面, Noun + である反面
ja: この車は速い反面、燃費が悪いです。
romaji: Kono kuruma wa hayai hanmen, nenpi ga warui desu.
en: On the one hand, this car is fast, but on the other hand, it has poor fuel efficiency.

meaning: Indicating target or intended audience.
formation: Noun + 向け
ja: この雑誌は若者向けです。
romaji: Kono zasshi wa wakamono-muke desu.
en: This magazine is aimed at young people.

meaning: Express a concern or fear that something undesirable might occur.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + 恐れがある
ja: 地震が来る恐れがあるため、避難所に行ってください。
romaji: Jishin ga kuru osore ga aru tame, hinanjo ni itte kudasai.
en: Please go to the evacuation center because there is a risk of an earthquake.

meaning: Expresses 'when' or 'in case of' specific situations or timings.
formation: Verb-ますstem + 折には, い-Adjective + 折には, な-Adjective + な折には, Noun + の折には
ja: 喉が渇く折には、このペットボトルの水を飲んでください。
romaji: Nodo ga kawaku ori ni wa, kono pettobotoru no mizu o nonde kudasai.
en: When you are thirsty, please drink the water from this plastic bottle.

meaning: Express the outcome after a period of time or a series of actions; 'after', 'as a result of'.
formation: Noun + 末
ja: 長い議論の末、ようやく意見がまとまった。
romaji: Nagai giron no sue, youyaku iken ga matomatta.
en: After a long discussion, opinions finally came together.

meaning: Expresses 'as soon as', 'depending on', or 'depending on the situation'.
formation: Verb-ます stem + 次第, Noun + 次第
ja: 仕事が終わり次第、帰ります。
romaji: Shigoto ga owari shidai, kaerimasu.
en: I will go home as soon as work finishes.

meaning: Depending on; based on.
formation: Verb-ますstem + 次第で, い-Adjective + 次第で, な-Adjective + だ次第で, Noun + 次第で
ja: 仕事が終わり次第で、家に帰ります。
romaji: Shigoto ga owari shidai de, ie ni kaerimasu.
en: I will go home depending on when I finish work.

meaning: Depends on; up to; as soon as; upon.
formation: Verb-ますstem + 次第です
ja: 天気次第ですが、明日ピクニックに行きたいです。
romaji: Tenki shidai desu ga, ashita pikunikku ni ikitai desu.
en: It depends on the weather, but I want to go for a picnic tomorrow.

meaning: Expresses a slight feeling or tendency towards a certain state or condition.
formation: Verb-te form + 気味, い-Adjective (remove い) + 気味, な-Adjective + 気味
ja: 最近寝不足気味で、ちょっと疲れています。
romaji: Saikin nebuzoku gimi de, chotto tsukarete imasu.
en: Lately, I've been somewhat sleep-deprived and a bit tired.

meaning: Expresses 'as long as', 'while', or 'to the extent of' a certain condition.
formation: Verb-casual + 限り, い-Adjective + 限り, な-Adjective + な限り, Noun + の限り
ja: 元気な限り、運動し続けます。
romaji: Genki na kagiri, undou shi tsuzukemasu.
en: As long as I am healthy, I will continue exercising.

meaning: Used to express the condition or situation during an event, meaning 'when', 'while', 'in the case of'.
formation: Verb-casual + 際に, い-Adjective + 際に, な-Adjective + な際に, Noun + の際に
ja: 出発の際に、パスポートを忘れないでください。
romaji: Shuppatsu no sai ni, pasupōto wo wasurenai de kudasai.
en: When departing, please do not forget your passport.
